f.title: Assess the need for reference information changes and propose them
f.statement: Based on cumulative safety data and the benefit-risk analysis, the MAH should assess the need for changes to the reference product information and propose changes, plus proposals to optimise benefit-risk for discussion with PBSL and incorporation into the RMP.

rows.quote: Based on the evaluation of the cumulative safety data and the benefit-risk analysis, the MAH should assess the need for further changes to the reference product information and propose changes as appropriate.

f.title: Provide local product information changes in a regional appendix where required
f.statement: If required by regional law, the MAH should provide in a regional appendix information on final, ongoing or proposed changes to the national authorised product information.

f.title: Attach the numbered PSUR appendices
f.statement: The PSUR/PBRER should be accompanied by appendices: reference information; SAE and ADR summary tabulations; signal tabulation; listing of safety studies; and, if desired, sources of information.
